newsitem.title: UK: Incentive offers discount scheme to UK media.
newsitem.headline: Incentive offers discount scheme to UK media.

text.p: Incentive, a London-based event and incentive management company, on Wednesday said it is launching a discount scheme for the advertising and media industry offering discounts at restaurants, bars, health clubs and shops.

Incentive said its Advantage 97 card has enlisted restaurants, bars, health clubs, and shops in Lond's Soho, Covent Gardens, Fitzrovia and Paddington area. The card, which costs 10 pounds per card, also offers discounted airport parking, electrical goods and international phone calls.
Incentive said it plans to expand the scheme into the City of London later this year and eventually cover all major cities in Britain.
